{dot} **Text messages:** Chatting in channels earns between 1 and 4 coins per message (1 min cooldown).
{dot} **Voice channels:** Being in voice earns between 3 and 10 coins every 2 min.
{dot} **Daily reward:** Claim your free coins every 20h with `/daily`.
{dot} **Work:** Use `/work` every hour for a fixed salary based on your RPG level.
{dot} **Mini-games:** Win big at dice (`/dice`), rps (`/rps`), roulette (`/roulette`) or by guessing (`/guess`).

b5_games_dice:
**{coins} `/dice <bet>`**
Roll two dice from 1 to 6.
{dot} **Double 6:** Win **3x** your bet!
{dot} **Other Double:** Win **2x** your bet!
{dot} **Sum >= 8:** Win **1.5x** your bet!
{dot} **Sum = 7:** Draw (bet refunded)
{dot} **Sum <= 6:** You lose your bet.
b5_games_rps:
**{coins} `/rps <choice> <bet>`**
Play Rock, Paper, Scissors against the bot.
{dot} **Win:** Win **2x** your bet!
{dot} **Draw:** Bet refunded
{dot} **Lose:** You lose your bet.
b5_games_roulette:
**{coins} `/roulette <bet>`**
Try Russian roulette with a 1-in-6 chance of getting shot.
{dot} **Survival (5/6):** Win **1.2x** your bet (20% profit)!
{dot} **Shot (1/6):** You lose your bet and **50 RPG HP**.
b5_games_guess:
**{coins} `/guess`**
Find a secret number between 1 and 100.
{dot} You have **7 tries**.
{dot} The bot helps you each time (higher / lower).
{dot} The faster you find it, the more coins you win (up to **200 coins**).
